nusmp.skill.book_glass.description: Glass Magic lets the mage shape sharp, translucent glass out of mana. Every shard cuts: a glass hit leaves a stacking bleed (up to 8 cuts on one target, each cut bleeding extra damage every second and leaking magicules), and four cuts make the wound leave the target fragile. The pages run from shard volleys and a piercing lance, through a glass blade, a step through the panes, Verre Detection that reveals everything nearby, a reflective prism barrier and a Shatter that pops every cut at once, to the zones of Shard Rain and Verre Fleur, the glass castle Le Chateau de Verre and the Crystal Carapace. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.grimoire_glass.description: Grimoire magic: Glass Magic. Razor shards that leave stacking bleed, a glass blade, panes that reveal and reflect, a Shatter that pops every cut, a flower of glass spikes and a castle of glass. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_strike: A single shard of glass thrown straight and hard. Fires a piercing glass bolt (8 damage, scaled by your EP) that cuts through every enemy on its line.
nusmp.page.book_glass.shard_volley: A fistful of glass shards, flung in a fan before they can catch the light. Fires 5 shards (3.5 damage each, scaled by your EP) in a narrow fan; every shard that hits leaves 1 glass cut, a bleed that stacks up to 8.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_lance: A lance of glass, thin enough to vanish edge-on and long enough to run through a whole line of foes. Fires a fast piercing lance (10 damage, scaled by your EP) that leaves 2 glass cuts and Fragility for 4 seconds on everything it passes through.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_epee: Glass Magic: Verre Epee. A blade of glass grows along the arm, light as air and sharp as a razor, and the mage moves faster for it. For 30 seconds your melee hits deal 4 extra damage (scaled by your EP) and leave a glass cut each, and you gain Speed I.
nusmp.page.book_glass.pane_step: The mage steps into one pane of glass and out of another further on, cutting everything between. Moves you up to 9 blocks forward; everything along the path takes 5 damage (scaled by your EP) and 1 glass cut, and you keep Speed II for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_detection: Glass Magic: Verre Detection. With the grimoire open, panes of glass are spread over the area and the light passing between them finds anyone hiding. Everything within 24 blocks (scaled by your EP) loses invisibility and glows for 12 seconds, through walls, and the number of presences found is shown to you.
nusmp.page.book_glass.prism_barrier: A pane of glass stands between the mage and the world and gives back what it is given. For 8 seconds incoming damage is cut by 40 percent, melee attackers take 35 percent of the blow back as thorns damage (at most 20) and are slowed, and projectiles that come within 2.8 blocks are turned around and become yours.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_shatter: A single sharp note, and every cut in the room opens at once. Everything within 8 blocks of the aim point (scaled by your EP) takes 3 damage plus 4 per glass cut it carries, and loses those cuts; enemy barriers, jails and spell projectiles in range are broken too.
nusmp.page.book_glass.shard_rain: The ceiling of the sky turns to glass, and the glass falls. For 5 seconds, over a circle of 5.5 blocks (scaled by your EP) at the aim point, shards fall every quarter second on up to 3 enemies in it, each dealing 2.8 damage (scaled by your EP) and 1 glass cut.
nusmp.page.book_glass.verre_fleur: Glass Creation Magic: Verre Fleur. The mage throws both hands to the sky and blade-like spikes of glass rise from the ground, big and small, folding together into the shape of a flower. Three waves of spikes burst at the aim point, growing outward to a radius of 5 blocks (scaled by your EP): 6, 7 and 8 damage, 2 to 3 glass cuts each and a throw into the air.
nusmp.page.book_glass.le_chateau_de_verr: Union Magic: Le Chateau de Verre. A castle of glass rises around the mage, with great glass flowers floating over its walls (the steel half of the original union is not part of this spell). A ring of glass panes 3 blocks high, radius 7 (scaled by your EP) with a gate in front of you, stands for 10 seconds; enemies inside take 4 damage and 1 glass cut every half second and are slowed and made to glow, while you and your allies inside gain Resistance and Regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_glass.crystal_carapace: The mage is sealed in a shell of crystal that shatters outward at the first sign of danger. Once a day: heals 30 percent of your health, grants Absorption IV for 30 seconds, Resistance II and the prism reflection for 10 seconds, and bursts shards over everything within 5 blocks (8 damage, scaled by your EP, and 3 glass cuts, thrown back).
